create_project_description: Set the project and customer name so you can start planning right away.
duplicate_project_description: Create a copy and adjust the project or customer name before you continue.
edit_project_description: Update the project and customer name without creating a new entry.
create_room_description: Set the room name, room type and an optional search tag.
duplicate_room_description: Create a copy of the room and adjust its name, room type or search tag right away.
edit_room_description: Update the selected room name, type and search tag.

billing_dialog_subtitle: Unlock every premium planning tool, keep the same workflow on every platform, and connect additional material portals directly into your TilePro setup.
billing_dialog_subscription_note: Subscriptions work across iOS, Android, macOS and Web. They can also unlock integrated material portals.
billing_dialog_lifetime_note: A lifetime buy only applies to the current platform. This offer unlocks premium on {platform} only.
billing_dialog_current_access_subscripti: This account already has an active cross-platform subscription. Premium and material portals are unlocked.
billing_dialog_current_access_lifetime: This account already has an active lifetime unlock on {platform}.
billing_dialog_subscription_caption: Works across iOS, Android, macOS and Web. Material portals can be connected.
billing_dialog_lifetime_caption: One-time unlock for {platform} only. Not cross-platform.
billing_dialog_missing_option: This option is not part of the current offering yet.
billing_dialog_offering_unavailable: No purchasable options could be loaded from RevenueCat for this platform yet.

billing_dialog_provider_unavailable: The billing provider is currently unavailable. Please try again later.

empty_rooms_instruction: Use the menu button in the bottom left and choose "Add Room" to start defining rooms.
empty_filtered_rooms_message: Adjust the filter above or create a new room with this type.
rooms_side_panel_empty_message: Select a room tile to show its summary here.
room_summary_surfaces_placeholder: A detailed surface summary will be added once the dedicated surface view is implemented.
room_summary_materials_placeholder: The material summary will be added after surfaces and material assignments are available.
settings_project_not_found: The project could not be loaded.
settings_project_scope_hint: Every change applies immediately to the currently opened project only and is saved right away.
settings_length_unit_description: Controls how project-wide lengths, edges and tile dimensions are displayed.
settings_area_unit_description: Defines the base unit for areas, cuts and quantity calculations inside the project.
settings_weight_unit_description: Defines the weight unit used for packaging, transport and material data.
settings_volume_unit_description: Controls how volume values for material, mixers or additives are shown.
settings_currency_description: The project currency is the base for price calculations. The last accepted exchange-rate snapshot stays stored in the project.
settings_currency_sync_description: Updates the conversion factors stored in this project with the latest online rates.
settings_currency_sync_hint: The last loaded exchange-rate snapshot stays attached to the project until you refresh it again.
settings_currency_sync_success: The latest exchange rates were written into the project.
settings_currency_sync_failed: The latest exchange rates could not be loaded.
settings_save_failed: The project settings could not be saved.
